scripts.resumes: mkdir -p .resume-build && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=.resume-build resumes/JulianaOBackend.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=.resume-build resumes/JulianaOPlatform.tex && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=.resume-build resumes/JulianaOProduct.tex && cp .resume-build/JulianaOBackend.pdf .resume-build/JulianaOPlatform.pdf .resume-build/JulianaOProduct.pdf public/resumes/ && rm -rf .resume-build
scripts.coverletter: mkdir -p .resume-build && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=.resume-build resumes/CoverLetter.tex && cp .resume-build/CoverLetter.pdf public/resumes/CoverLetter.pdf && rm -rf .resume-build
scripts.resume: mkdir -p .resume-build && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -output-directory=.resume-build resumes/JulianaOyolaResume.tex && cp .resume-build/JulianaOyolaResume.pdf public/resumes/JulianaOyolaResume.pdf && rm -rf .resume-build
